EQP-0003 Fault-injection lead simulator

TitleFault-injection lead simulator
ModelNeurolab FL-2
Needed byVER-0002
Used inEVD-0002

Purpose

Sits between the implant and its leads: opens and recloses the sense electrode on command, and monitors delivered current on the stimulation lead.
